applyTo: "CMakeLists.txt,**/CMakeLists.txt,configure.ac,**/Makefile.am,src/*.sh*,eval/**,ssil/**"

# HELIOS Build, Run Scripts, eval/ and ssil/

## TL;DR
helios-base builds with either CMake or autotools against an installed librcsc, producing `sample_player`, `sample_coach`, and `sample_trainer`; the start scripts launch them against a running rcssserver-16.
- Build: `./bootstrap && ./configure && make` (verified in `README.md:23-28`), or CMake with `LIBRCSC_INSTALL_DIR` (`CMakeLists.txt:19`).
- Find librcsc with `--with-librcsc=PREFIX` or the probed paths in `configure.ac:39-56`; CMake searches `LIBRCSC_INSTALL_DIR`.
- Run: `src/start.sh` (players + coach), `src/keepaway.sh` (keepers + takers + trainer), `src/train.sh` (broken as shipped, see below).
- `eval/` packages a binary release; `ssil/` launches a team over ssh on three client machines. Both assume hard-coded paths.
- The repository has no tests.
- **Open the full file when:** changing build configuration, adding a source file, or editing a launch script.

## Overview
- Versions: CMake `project(helios-base VERSION 2023.03)` (`CMakeLists.txt:3`); autotools `AC_INIT([helios-base],[2023.03],…)` (`configure.ac:5`).
- README: works with rcssserver-16 and needs Boost 1.38 or later plus the latest librcsc (`README.md:4-5, 12-14`).
- Two build systems maintain the same source lists by hand. I diffed `src/player/CMakeLists.txt` against `src/player/Makefile.am` `sample_player_SOURCES`: no differences. The trainer list matches too; `src/coach/Makefile.am` was not diffed.

## Architecture
### CMake (root `CMakeLists.txt`, `src/CMakeLists.txt`, `src/*/CMakeLists.txt`)
- C++17 (`CMakeLists.txt:10-11`), default build type Release (`:13-15`), flags `-W -Wall` (`:16`).
- librcsc: `LIBRCSC_INSTALL_DIR` cache path, default `$ENV{HOME}/.local;$ENV{HOME}/local` (`:19`); `find_library(rcsc)` in those paths with suffix `lib` (`:21-27`); `find_path(rcsc/types.h)` with suffix `include` (`:30-37`). Missing either is `FATAL_ERROR`.
- Boost: `find_package(Boost 1.36.0 COMPONENTS system REQUIRED)` (`:47`); ZLIB optional (`:53-56`).
- `cmake-config.h.in` → `config.h` (`:59-63`).
- `src/CMakeLists.txt`: adds `player`, `coach`, `trainer` (`:2-4`); configures `start.sh`, `keepaway.sh`, `train.sh` from their `.in` templates and copies them, plus `formations-dt`, `formations-keeper`, `formations-taker`, `player.conf`, `coach.conf`, `start-debug.sh`, `start-offline.sh`, into `${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/bin` (`:6-44`).
- Targets: `sample_player` (`src/player/CMakeLists.txt:1`), `sample_coach` (`src/coach/CMakeLists.txt:2`), `sample_trainer` (`src/trainer/CMakeLists.txt:2`). All use `RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/bin`.
- Not documented: the README gives no CMake command line. I did not run CMake.

### Autotools (`bootstrap`, `configure.ac`, `Makefile.am`)
- `bootstrap`: `autoreconf -i -f` (`bootstrap:3-4`).
- `configure.ac`: C++17 via `AX_CXX_COMPILE_STDCXX_17` (`:25`); `AX_BOOST_BASE([1.38.0])` and `AX_BOOST_SYSTEM` (`:29-30`); `AC_CONFIG_SRCDIR([config.h.in])` (`:6`). `config.h.in` is not checked in; it is expected to be generated by `autoreconf` (not verified by running).
- librcsc location (`configure.ac:35-56`): `--with-librcsc=PREFIX` sets `-I PREFIX/include` and `-L PREFIX/lib`; without it, the first of `$HOME/.local`, `$HOME/local`, `$HOME/rcss`, `/opt/robocup`, `/opt`, `/opt/local` that contains `include/rcsc/types.h` is used. Default `LIBRCSC_LIBDIR` is `/usr/local/lib` (`:37`).
- Link checks: `-lm`, `-lz` (optional), `-lrcsc` via `AC_CHECK_LIB(rcsc, main)` (`:61-68`), header `rcsc/types.h` (`:72`).
- Generated files: `src/start.sh`, `src/keepaway.sh`, `src/train.sh` (`:99-109`, the chmod step is listed as extra macro arguments).
- `src/Makefile.am`: `SUBDIRS = player coach trainer .` (`:3`); lists config data as `noinst_DATA` (`:5-53`); `all-local` symlinks the three binaries up into `src/` (`:63-66`).
- `src/player/Makefile.am` sets `-W -Wall` (`:8, 254-256`).

### Where things are produced
- CMake: binaries in `<build>/bin`, scripts in `<build>/bin`.
- Autotools: binaries in each `src/*/` subdirectory, plus symlinks `src/sample_player`, `src/sample_coach`, `src/sample_trainer` (`src/Makefile.am:63-66`). `eval/archive.sh` expects this layout (see below).

## Patterns & Conventions
- Launch scripts are shell templates (`*.sh.in`) with `@LIBRCSC_LIBDIR@` substituted at configure time; they prepend that path to `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` (`src/start.sh.in:12-20`, `keepaway.sh.in:13-21`, `train.sh.in:4-12`).
- Scripts resolve their directory with `DIR=\`dirname $0\`` and call binaries from that directory.
- Server defaults: player host `localhost`, port `6000`; coach port `port + 2`; debug server port `port + 32` (`start.sh.in:27-28, 305-306`).

## Integration Points
### `src/start.sh.in` (players + coach)
- Options (`usage`, `:55-83`; parsing `:85-287`): `-h/--host`, `-p/--port`, `-P/--coach-port`, `-t/--teamname` (default `HELIOS_base`), `-n/--number` (default 11), `-u/--unum`, `-C/--without-coach`, `-f/--formation DIR` (default `formations-dt`), `--team-graphic FILE`, `--offline-logging`, `--offline-client-mode`, `--debug`, `--debug_*`, `--debug-start-time`, `--debug-end-time`, `--debug-server-connect`, `--debug-server-host/port`, `--debug-server-logging`, `--log-dir`, `--debug-log-ext`, `--fullstate ignore|reference|override`, and the dataset-logger options `--denoise-log-dir DIR`, `--denoise-game-id ID` (default `<timestamp>_<team>`, shared by all players of one run), `--no-denoise-landmarks`, `--no-denoise-raw`. Use them with `--fullstate reference` so the ground truth is received. They are passed as `--denoise_log_dir/--denoise_game_id/--denoise_log_landmarks false/--denoise_log_raw false` to players only (`launch_player`, `:360-367`), not to the coach; output format: the librcsc `denoise-dataset` instruction.
- Runs `ping -c 1 $host` first (`:357`).
- Starts the goalie with `-g` (`launch_player -g`, `:374-381`), then players 2..N (`:386-400`), then `sample_coach` unless `-C` (`:406-424`).
- `-u` only matters with `--offline-client-mode` (`:322, 340-346`); in online mode it has no effect.
- Each process gets `--player-config src/player.conf --config_dir <set> -h HOST -p PORT -t TEAM` (`:308-309`).

### Exp2 self localization

Build and install librcsc from `denoise-exp2` before building this branch.
Pass `--self-localization shadow|apply --self-localization-model FILE` to
`start.sh` with a readable Step 05 weight export and `--denoise-log-dir DIR`.
The launcher passes the options only to players. Use `--fullstate reference`
to score against server truth and pass the same `--denoise-game-id` to both teams.
Use a distinct ID per match in parallel runs. The default mode is `off`.
See the server repository's `experiments/exp2/README.md` for the full run and
export workflow.

### `src/keepaway.sh.in` (keepers, takers, trainer)
- Options: `-h`, `-p`, `-P`, `-f DIR`, `--offline-logging`, `--offline-client-mode`, `--debug`, `--debug-server-*`, `--log-dir`, `--debug-log-ext`, `--fullstate`.
- Starts 3 players as team `Keeper` with `formations-keeper` (`:258-268`), then 2 as `Taker` with `formations-taker` (`:272-282`), then `sample_trainer -h HOST -t Keeper --use_ear on` unless offline (`:284-286`). No coach.
- Known problems: `-f DIR` sets `config_dir` (`:126`) but the agents use the fixed keeper/taker dirs (`:265, 279`). `--debug_*` values are stored in `debug_opt` (`:143-145`) but the launch line uses `debugopt` (`:256`), so they are dropped.

### `src/train.sh.in` (training; broken as shipped)
- Options: `-h/--host` and `-t/--teamname` only (`:34-77`). Team name defaults to `HELIOS`.
- Runs `${DIR}/sample_player` once with `-n 11` (`:89`), and `${DIR}/helios_trainer` (`:18, 97`). No build target produces `helios_trainer`; the trainer target is `sample_trainer`.
- Uses `${DIR}/formations-train` (`:23`), which does not exist in `src/`.
- Coach launch is commented out (`:93-95`).

### `src/start-debug.sh` and `src/start-offline.sh`
- `start-debug.sh`: `./start.sh --offline-logging --debug --debug-server-connect "$@"` (`:3`).
- `start-offline.sh`: `./start.sh --offline-client-mode --debug --debug-server-logging "$@"` (`:3`).
- Both call `./start.sh` relative to the current directory, so run them from the directory that contains `start.sh`.

### Server connection
- Server: rcssserver-16 (README). The scripts do not start the server.
- Defaults: player `localhost:6000` (`src/player.conf:10-11`), coach `localhost:6002` (`src/coach.conf:12-13`), team `HELIOS_base` (`src/player.conf:3`).

### `eval/` (binary release packaging)
- `eval/config`: `LIBDIR=$HOME/local/lib/`, `TEAMDIR=../`, `PACKAGEDIR="helios-base"`, `TEAM_NAME="HELIOS_base"`.
- `eval/archive.sh`: copies `librcsc.*` from `LIBDIR`, copies `${TEAMDIR}/src/player/sample_player` and `${TEAMDIR}/src/coach/sample_coach` (`:30-31`), the `formations-dt` set, `player.conf`, and `coach.conf`; strips binaries; substitutes `@DIST_DATETIME@` and `@TEAM_NAME@` in the package `start` script (`:41-44`); tars the directory.
- The archive paths match the autotools layout, not CMake's `bin/`, so with a CMake build `archive.sh` will not find the binaries.
- `eval/template/start` is the per-agent launcher (`HOST DIR NUM`). It hard-codes `teamname="HELIOS_base"` after the `@TEAM_NAME@` line, so the substitution is overwritten. `eval/template/start.sh` starts 12 agents (numbers 1-12) with sleeps; `eval/template/kill` sends TERM then KILL to `sample_player` and `sample_coach`.

### `ssil/` (multi-machine team launch over ssh)
- `ssil/start` takes: `$1` team directory, `$2`, `$3`, `$4` client hosts, `$5` server host, `$6` login. It runs `ssh … -f $1/start1 $5`, then `start2`, then `start3`, and on Ctrl-C runs `kill1`, `kill2`, `kill3` on the hosts (`:10-27`).
- `start1.tmpl`: goalie (`-g`) plus 3 players (4 agents). `start2.tmpl`: 4 players. `start3.tmpl`: 3 players and the coach (sleep 2, then `sample_coach`). Total 11 players.
- `kill{1,2,3}.tmpl`: `killall` TERM then KILL for `sample_player` and `sample_coach`.
- The `.tmpl` files contain `TEAMNAME` and `/home/ssil/2d/TEAMNAME` placeholders. No script in the repository renders them to `start1`, `start2`, and so on; `ssil/start` expects the rendered names.

## Build & Test
- Build (verified in README): `./bootstrap`, `./configure [--with-librcsc=PREFIX]`, `make`, run from the repository root.
- Start a team: from the build tree or `src/`, run `./start.sh` after rcssserver is running.
- Tests: none. The repository has no test directories, test files, or CI configuration.

## Important Notes
- librcsc must be built and installed first. The helios build only checks that the library and `rcsc/types.h` exist, not its version.
- `train.sh` cannot run as shipped (missing `helios_trainer` target and `formations-train/`).
- `keepaway.sh -f` and its `--debug_*` options are ignored (see above).
- `start.sh` launches all agents even when `-u` is given (outside offline mode).
- `obsolete/` scripts (`reconnect.sh.in`, `start-oz.sh`) reference `formations-433`, `formations-uva`, and `formations-bpn`; they are not installed by either build system.
- Hard-coded paths to check before use: `/home/ssil/2d/TEAMNAME` (`ssil/*.tmpl`), `$HOME/local/lib/` (`eval/config:3`), and `/tmp` log dir (`src/player.conf:17`).
